source.check: Nominations, Londonderry Sentinel 19 May 1949 p6 (division by division; the only contest Ardmore, Browne withdrawn in Middle Liberties) and Derry Journal 18 May 1949 ('The other outgoing members are returned unopposed'); full names from the Returning Officer's notice, Derry Journal 8 Jun 1949 p1.

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Londonderry (Derry) rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two contests were nominated; John S. Browne (U.) withdrew in Middle Liberties, leaving Patrick G. Coyle returned unopposed. Only Ardmore was actually polled. The eleven unopposed members added from the nominations lists (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6; Derry Journal, 18 May 1949), Tamnaherin from the Derry Journal list; full names checked against the Returning Officer's notice (Derry Journal, 8 June 1949, p. 1) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
